summary.name: Cutaway / Exploded 3D Illustration (Digital and 3D Aesthetics; extracted provenance).
summary.visualIdentity: Genuine 3D component geometry with section views and exploded assemblies that explain internal structure. Parts separate along meaningful axes, labels stay attached through camera motion, and assembly orientation is preserved. Internal flow paths use semantic colors, then parts reassemble precisely. Neutral staging stays distinct from black barrels, red tissue, blue vessels and gold materials.
summary.suitableUses: Explicitly suited to explaining internal structure and assembly relationships of physical objects. The reviewed example is a lens mechanism with a light path. Inferred fits include technical product explainers, mechanical or optical teaching, and assembly sequences. Audience, duration, and aspect ratio are unspecified; the reference values are optional examples only.
summary.limitations: Flat SVG depth illusions are rejected because the style requires true 3D geometry. Materials are procedural, transmission is approximated, and simulated physics is not validated. Previews must disclose procedural approximations. glTF parts are used only when authorized assets are supplied. No motion reference is selected, and Blender is unnecessary.
summary.palette: Background policy is scene_dependent, a style-compatible suggestion for new artwork. Example tokens are background #101820, foreground #EFF4F7, steel #8196A5, glass cyan #61D4DC, flow blue #628BF4 and flow warm #EF9F5C. These were authored defaults, not source-verified, and no gradient is enabled. Task-approved colors override them. Foreground text needs 4.5:1 contrast on composited pixels.
summary.motionAndInteraction: GSAP owns part offsets along the optical axis and a calm camera arc. Labels are reprojected from part anchors at each seek. Leader lines draw with DrawSVGPlugin, and arrowheads appear only after the stroke arrives. Reference timing is 0–0.5s assembled, 0.5–1.5s separation, 1.5–2.4s held labeled path and 3s reassembly. No user interaction is specified beyond optional reduced-motion controls in HTML.
summary.audio: Audio is not prescribed by the style. Music, voiceover, sound effects, ambience, or silence are optional and task-specific. Mechanism sounds should match only meaningful visible action. Silence is valid, and provided audio takes precedence. Catalog previews are silent. Instrumental music must not be defaulted when no audio input is given.
summary.assetRequirements: No uploads are required. Procedural geometry and materials are the default, and glTF models are used only when authorized. Supplied references are optional. Source posts were not visually inspected. Any audio, voice, or external asset must be created or authorized separately before use.
summary.combinations: Suggested supporting style style-097 adds causal labels and internal flow explanation. Suggested style-093 adds concise technical headings. Keep this style's geometry, material and background roles dominant. Avoid competing full-frame treatments and invented measurements or physically inaccurate claims.
summary.productionApproach: Style renderer uses Three.js, PBR materials and SVG overlays. Motion engine uses GSAP and DrawSVGPlugin with one owner per property. HyperFrames is the default composition and export pipeline, with Remotion as a documented fallback only. Run check, snapshot and render, then verify decoded frames, seeks and contrast.
